mapper.select: select * from user where user_id = #{user_id} and password = #{password}
mapper.insert: insert into user(username, password, sex, phone, user_source, status, can_comment, can_upload, register_time, created_at, updated_at) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{sex}, #{phone}, 'web', #{status}, 1, 1, NOW(), NOW(), NOW());
mapper.update: update user set password = #{password}, username = #{username}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_url = #{avatar_url}, sex = #{sex}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = NOW() where user_id = #{user_id}
